The Fall 2026 course page and its linked class-policies page (.cache/text/v2c-tennessee-knoxville-C6-policies.txt) contain no mention of AI, ChatGPT, Copilot or LLMs; the policies page covers only plagiarism and cheating in general terms. The Fall 2026 COSC 361 Operating Systems page has no AI policy either, but it is a choice course so it was not used.
